story.iWant: to receive proactive alerts from my Home Assistant automations via Telegram
story.soThat: Annie can notify me about important home events like motion detection, door left open, or temperature changes without me asking

task.title: Create MQTT Subscriber Class (AC: #1, #2, #6, #8, #9)
task.subtask: Add configuration loading: HA_MQTT_BROKER, HA_MQTT_PORT, HA_MQTT_USERNAME, HA_MQTT_PASSWORD, HA_MQTT_TOPICS
Implement `start()` method to connect and subscribe
Add connection check: skip if HA_MQTT_BROKER not configured
Implement reconnection with 5s backoff on disconnect

task.title: Implement Message Parsing (AC: #3, #4)
task.subtask: Implement `parse_message(payload: bytes, topic: str) -> dict` method
Try JSON parsing first: extract title, message, entity_id, state
Fall back to plain text: use payload as message, default title
Handle malformed JSON gracefully (treat as plain text)
Validate required fields (at minimum: message content)

task.title: Implement Telegram Forwarding (AC: #5, #7)
task.subtask: Add structured logging with topic, message_type, forwarded

task.title: Integrate with Backend Startup (AC: #8)
task.subtask: Add MQTT subscriber to backend startup in `main.py`
Ensure subscriber runs as background task (asyncio)
Handle startup gracefully if MQTT not configured

criterion.title: Connect to Mosquitto Broker on Startup
criterion.then: the MQTT subscriber connects to the broker at HA_MQTT_BROKER:HA_MQTT_PORT
criterion.testable: Start service with valid broker config, verify connection in logs

criterion.title: Subscribe to Configured Topics
criterion.then: it subscribes to all topics matching the pattern (wildcard # supported)
criterion.testable: Verify subscription to "annie/alerts/#" in mock client calls

criterion.title: Parse JSON Messages
criterion.then: it extracts title, message, and optional fields correctly
criterion.testable: Send JSON message, verify parsed fields

criterion.title: Parse Plain Text Messages
criterion.given: a message in plain text format
criterion.then: it uses the text as the message body with a default title
criterion.testable: Send plain text, verify message body used

criterion.title: Forward Messages to Telegram
criterion.given: a parsed MQTT message and HA_MQTT_ALERT_USER_ID configured
criterion.then: it is forwarded to Telegram via TelegramDelivery.send_message() with format: **{title}**, {message}, _Topic: {topic}_
criterion.testable: Mock TelegramDelivery, verify send_message called with correct format

criterion.title: Auto-Reconnect on Connection Loss
criterion.then: it attempts reconnection with 5-second backoff, max 30 seconds to reconnect
criterion.testable: Simulate disconnect, verify reconnect attempts with backoff

criterion.title: Log All Received Messages
criterion.then: structured logs include: topic, message_type (json/text), forwarded (true/false)
criterion.testable: Check logs for required fields after message processing

criterion.title: Graceful Shutdown on SIGTERM
criterion.then: the MQTT client disconnects cleanly before process exit
criterion.testable: Send SIGTERM, verify clean disconnect in logs

criterion.title: Skip if MQTT Not Configured
criterion.given: HA_MQTT_BROKER is empty or not set
criterion.then: the MQTT subscriber is not started (no error, just skipped)
criterion.testable: Start without HA_MQTT_BROKER, verify no MQTT connection attempted

criterion.title: Unit Tests with Mocked MQTT Client
criterion.then: all test cases pass with >90% code coverage using mocked aiomqtt client
criterion.testable: Run pytest with coverage, verify threshold met

file.reason: Existing Telegram delivery class to reuse for forwarding MQTT alerts. Provides send_proactive_message() method, markdown-to-HTML conversion, rate limit handling, and delivery result tracking.
Configuration module pattern to follow for loading HA_MQTT_* environment variables. Contains SENSITIVE_VARS list for masking passwords.
FastAPI startup/shutdown event handlers where MQTT subscriber should be integrated. Shows pattern for starting background tasks with asyncio.create_task().
Logging utility to use for structured logging with extra fields (topic, message_type, forwarded, duration_ms).
Test patterns to follow: pytest fixtures with mock_redis and mock_bot, AsyncMock for async testing, validation error testing, rate limit testing.
Export location showing how to import TelegramDelivery class.

package.note: NEW - async MQTT client for subscriber (added in Story 16.5)

package.name: python-telegram-bot
package.note: existing - Telegram delivery via TelegramDelivery class

constraints.constraint: Follow existing async pattern in proactive/telegram_delivery.py for async service classes
Use get_config() for loading environment variables, not direct os.getenv()
Add HA_MQTT_PASSWORD to SENSITIVE_VARS list (Story 16.4 prerequisite)
Use structured logging with extra={} for all log messages
New service file goes in backend/api/ directory (not MCP server)
Use unittest.mock.AsyncMock for mocking aiomqtt client
Start MQTT subscriber as asyncio background task in main.py startup_event
Register shutdown handler to call subscriber.stop() on SIGTERM
Never crash on MQTT errors - log warning and continue
Graceful skip if HA_MQTT_BROKER not configured (no error)

interface.name: MQTTSubscriber
interface.signature: class MQTTSubscriber: def __init__(self, broker: str, port: int, topics: str, username: str = "", password: str = "", alert_user_id: str = ""): ... async def start(self) -> None: """Connect to broker, subscribe to topics, and process messages in loop.""" ... async def stop(self) -> None: """Gracefully disconnect from broker.""" ... async def handle_message(self, message) -> None: """Parse message and forward to Telegram.""" ... def parse_message(self, payload: bytes, topic: str) -> dict: """Parse JSON or plain text payload into message dict.""" ...

interface.name: TelegramDelivery.send_proactive_message
interface.signature: async def send_proactive_message( self, user_id: str, message: str, trigger_id: str, parse_mode: str = "HTML", max_retries: Optional[int] = None ) -> DeliveryResult:

interface.name: MQTT Message Format
interface.signature:
# JSON format (from Home Assistant automations) { "title": str, # Alert title "message": str, # Alert body "entity_id": str, # Optional: triggering entity "state": str # Optional: entity state }
# Plain text format "Motion detected in backyard"

tests.standards: Follow existing test patterns from backend/tests/proactive/. Use pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests. Create fixtures for mock_redis and mock MQTT client using AsyncMock. Mock external dependencies (aiomqtt, TelegramDelivery) to isolate unit tests. Use structured assertions to verify log output contains required fields.

locations.location: backend/tests/unit/ (for unit tests following project convention)

ideas.idea: test_mqtt_connect() - Mock aiomqtt.Client, verify connect called with correct broker/port

test_mqtt_receive_plain_text() - Send plain text, verify message body used with default title

test_mqtt_graceful_shutdown() - Call stop(), verify running=False and client disconnect
test_mqtt_skip_when_not_configured() - Empty broker, verify start() returns early without error
